metadata.title: Bible Map — biblical places
metadata.scope: Every mappable place record in the Protestant Bible covered by the source dataset
metadata.source: Adapted from OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data (CC BY 4.0)
metadata.method: Each ancient place follows the highest-scoring mappable ancient identification, then its strongest resolved modern basis. Source IDs and alternative proposals are retained. Dizahab uses the explicitly labeled project preference for Dahab.
